blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A bill that restricts minors or those below 18 years old from using social media has been approved on second reading at the Senate. Senate Bill No. 2424, or the Child Online Safety and Protection Act, which seeks to protect children from physical, mental and social harms from social media platforms, was passed on second reading Wednesday evening. Sponsored by Sen. Robinhood Padilla, the measure defines the age-restricted social media platforms as any electronic services that primarily facilitates online social interactions, and permits users to publish content accessible to other users.
